description: 用户登录系统
guidance: 调用 /v1/cl/user/login 接口以使用用户名和密码进行登录。需要提供一个在10分钟内有效的Unix时间戳。

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

description: Create a DDoS attack flow template for simulating UDP flood attacks
guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/create to create a new DDoS attack flow template. This step is aimed at setting up a UDP flood attack simulation. The request should include a timestamp (valid within 10 minutes), an allocated session ID, and the body containing details of the attack flow. Note that the timestamp must be in Unix format.

input.name: body
input.description: Details of the attack flow to be created, including parameters such as attack type, duration, and target IP. Refer to the definition of attackapi.AttackFlowCreateRequest for more details.

output.name: response
output.description: The response object will contain the result of creating the DDoS attack flow template. For exact structure, refer to the definition of attackapi.AttackFlowCreateResponse.

description: Update DDoS attack flow parameters
guidance: This step aims to set the peak traffic to 500Mbps, test duration to 60 seconds, and target IP to 11.0.0.1/24 by calling /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/param/update with POST method. The timestamp must be a Unix timestamp and valid within 10 minutes. A session ID is also required as part of the query parameters.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for updating DDoS attack flow parameters

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response from updating DDoS attack flow parameters

description: Save DDoS attack flow template for future use
guidance: Use the /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/save endpoint to save a configured DDoS attack flow template. This step requires a valid session ID and timestamp, where the timestamp should be a Unix timestamp that is not older than 10 minutes.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: Unix timestamp, must be within 10 minutes of current time

input.name: SESSION_ID
input.description: Allocated session ID from previous login or session creation

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response body containing the result of saving the DDoS attack flow template

description: 初始化一个新的数据捕获过程，准备记录即将发生的攻击流量
guidance: 通过调用/v1/cl/capture/start接口使用POST方法开始一个新的数据捕获。此步骤依赖于有效的会话ID，并且提供的UNIX时间戳应在接下来的10分钟内有效。

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

output.name: response
output.description: 响应体，符合CaptureStartResponse定义

description: Run a specified testcase with given session ID and timestamp
guidance: Call /v1/cl/testcase/run to execute a predefined DDoS attack template, initiating an UDP flood. Ensure the timestamp is within 10 minutes of the current time and that you have a valid session ID.

input.name: body
input.description: request body for running the testcase, see schema for details

output.name: response_body
output.description: The response body will contain the result of the testcase run, see schema for details

description: Stop the data capture process after an attack
guidance: Call /v1/cl/capture/stop to stop the data capture process. This API requires a valid session ID and a timestamp that is valid for 10 minutes.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for stopping the capture

output.name: response
output.description: Response body for stopping the capture

description: Start downloading captured packets for local analysis
guidance: Call /v1/cl/capture/download/start to initiate the download of captured packets. This requires a valid session_id and a timestamp that is not older than 10 minutes, along with the request body containing the necessary details for the download process.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body containing the necessary details for starting the download

output.name: response
output.description: Response object containing the result of the download start request

description: Search for statistics history of a specified testcase instance
guidance: Call /v1/cl/stats/search with POST method to retrieve the specific statistics data. Ensure that the timestamp is within the last 10 minutes and a valid session_id is provided.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Request body containing the search criteria as per StatsSearchRequest schema

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response body containing the result of the stats search as per StatsSearchResponse schema

description: 用户注销当前登录状态
guidance: 通过调用/v1/cl/user/logout接口来注销当前用户的登录状态。此步骤需要提供有效的session_id以及一个在10分钟内有效的时间戳。使用POST方法发送请求，并确保Content-Type为application/json。

description: 用户登录以获取会话ID
guidance: 调用 /v1/cl/user/login 接口进行用户登录，需要提供一个有效的时间戳参数（有效期为10分钟），并携带登录请求体。

input.name: BASE_URL
input.description: API base URL without trailing slash

input.name: body
input.description: User login request body, containing username and password for login

output.name: response
output.description: User login response, containing session_id and other related information

description: List all DDoS attack flow template information
guidance: The purpose of this step is to check for the availability of DDoS attack flow templates, particularly those that can be used for UDP flood attacks. To achieve this, call the /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/list endpoint using the GET method. Note that the 'timestamp' parameter should be a valid Unix timestamp and must not have expired (valid for 10 minutes). Additionally, the 'session_id' parameter, which is allocated upon successful login or session creation, is required.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

output.name: response
output.description: Response body containing the list of DDoS attack flow templates

description: Create or update a DDoS attack flow template
guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/create with POST method to either create a new DDoS attack flow template or update an existing one. The request must include a valid session_id and timestamp, where the timestamp should be a Unix timestamp and is valid for 10 minutes.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for creating or updating DDoS attack flow template, refer to #/definitions/attackapi.AttackFlowCreateRequest for schema details

output.name: response
output.description: Response object containing result of the operation, refer to #/definitions/attackapi.AttackFlowCreateResponse for schema details

description: Update DDoS attack flow parameters
guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/param/update to set the target IP address of a DDoS attack to 11.0.0.1/24, configure the peak attack traffic to 500Mbps, and set the duration to 60 seconds. The timestamp should be a Unix timestamp that is valid for 10 minutes, and the session_id must be provided.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for updating DDoS attack flow parameters

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response body from the API call

description: 开始新的数据包捕获过程，以便记录攻击期间的数据流
guidance: 使用POST方法调用/v1/cl/capture/start接口来启动一个新的数据包捕获过程。此操作需要一个有效的session_id和一个未过期（10分钟内）的时间戳。

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: 请求体，包含CaptureStartRequest所需的所有信息

output.name: response_body
output.description: 响应体，包含CaptureStartResponse定义的所有字段

description: Run a specified testcase with provided session and timestamp
guidance: This step aims to execute a pre-defined testcase by calling the /v1/cl/testcase/run endpoint. Use POST method, ensure the timestamp is a valid Unix timestamp within the last 10 minutes, and provide an allocated session id as part of the query parameters. The body should contain the TestcaseRunRequest object.

input.name: body
input.description: TestcaseRunRequest object that contains details about the testcase to run

output.name: response
output.description: TestcaseRunResponse object containing the result of running the testcase

description: Stop the current packet capture process
guidance: After completing an attack, call /v1/cl/capture/stop to stop the ongoing packet capture. This API requires a valid session ID and a timestamp (valid for 10 minutes) as query parameters, and a request body conforming to CaptureStopRequest schema.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: CaptureStopRequest object containing necessary fields to stop the capture

output.name: response_body
output.description: CaptureStopResponse object from the response

description: 获取与本次攻击相关的统计数据类别
guidance: 通过调用/v1/cl/stats/category/search接口并提供必要的参数（如时间戳、会话ID以及请求体）来搜索指定测试实例的实时统计类别数据。注意，时间戳应为Unix时间戳格式且在10分钟内有效。

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for the stats category search request

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response body containing the result of the stats category search

description: 查询指定测试用例实例的历史统计信息
guidance: 使用POST方法调用/v1/cl/stats/search接口来搜索特定测试用例的统计数据历史。确保timestamp参数为当前时间且在接下来10分钟内有效，同时需要提供一个有效的session_id。

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: 请求体，包含统计搜索请求的具体内容

output.name: response
output.description: 返回的统计搜索响应对象

description: User logout
guidance: Call /v1/cl/user/logout to safely end the user's session. This API requires a valid session_id and a timestamp (valid for 10 minutes). The request body must follow the schema defined in alps.UserLogoutRequest.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: request body following the schema of alps.UserLogoutRequest

output.name: response_body
output.description: response body following the schema of alps.UserLogoutResponse

description: 用户登录以获取系统访问权限
guidance: 调用 /v1/cl/user/login 接口进行用户登录，该接口需要一个在请求体中的UserLoginRequest对象和一个作为查询参数的UNIX时间戳（有效期10分钟）。通过此步骤可以获取用户的session_id。

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: 当前时间的UNIX时间戳，必须在接下来的10分钟内有效

input.name: body
input.description: 包含用户名和密码等信息的UserLoginRequest对象

output.name: session_id
output.description: 从响应中获取的会话ID

description: Create a UDP flood attack DDoS flow template
guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/create to create a DDoS attack flow template for a UDP flood. The request must include a valid timestamp, session_id, and the body should contain the AttackFlowCreateRequest details. Note that the timestamp is a Unix timestamp and it should be valid within 10 minutes.

input.name: body
input.description: Details of the attack flow creation request

output.name: response
output.description: The response from creating a DDoS attack flow template

description: Update DDoS attack flow parameters
guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/param/update to update the DDoS attack flow parameters, including setting the peak traffic and test duration. This call requires a valid session ID and a timestamp that is not older than 10 minutes.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body containing the updated DDoS attack flow parameters

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response from updating DDoS attack flow parameters

description: Save DDoS attack flow template
guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/save to save a configured DDoS attack flow template. This step requires a valid session ID and timestamp within the last 10 minutes.

output.name: response
output.description: Response containing the result of saving the DDoS attack flow template

description: Create a new testcase based on a saved DDoS attack traffic template
guidance: This step aims to create a new test case using the provided DDoS attack traffic template. To achieve this, you need to POST to /v1/cl/testcase/create with required parameters including a timestamp valid within 10 minutes and an allocated session id. The request body should follow the structure defined in TestcaseCreateRequest.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: The content of the request body following the schema of TestcaseCreateRequest as defined in the API specification

output.name: response
output.description: The response object follows the schema of TestcaseCreateResponse as defined in the API specification

description: Update a test parameter
guidance: Call /v1/cl/testcase/param/update to update a specific test parameter. This step requires a valid session_id and a timestamp that is not older than 10 minutes. The request body should contain the necessary information for updating the parameter, as defined in the TestcaseParamUpdateRequest schema.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: The request body containing the details of the test parameter to be updated, as per the TestcaseParamUpdateRequest schema

output.name: response
output.description: The response object, as per the TestcaseParamUpdateResponse schema

description: Run a specified testcase
guidance: Call /v1/cl/testcase/run to execute a predefined testcase. This API requires a valid session_id and timestamp, which should be generated within the last 10 minutes.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for running a testcase

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response body from running a testcase

description: 查询当前测试用例支持的所有统计类别
guidance: 通过调用 /v1/cl/stats/category/search 接口来获取指定测试实例的实时统计类别。此步骤需要提供一个有效的 session_id 和 timestamp，其中 timestamp 是一个 Unix 时间戳，有效期为 10 分钟。

input.name: body
input.description: 请求体，包含搜索统计类别的具体参数

output.name: response
output.description: 返回结果，包含统计类别的信息

description: Search for detailed statistics of a specified testcase instance based on selected statistical categories
guidance: Call /v1/cl/stats/search using POST method with required parameters to fetch the history of statistics. Ensure that the timestamp is within the last 10 minutes and use an allocated session id.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for stats search request

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response containing the result of the stats search

description: User logout
guidance: Call /v1/cl/user/logout to safely log out the user after all tests are completed. This endpoint requires a valid session_id and a timestamp that is not older than 10 minutes. The body of the request should follow the UserLogoutRequest schema.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: Unix timestamp, must be within the last 10 minutes

input.name: SESSION_ID
input.description: Allocated session id from login response

input.name: body
input.description: Request body following the UserLogoutRequest schema

output.name: response
output.description: Response body following the UserLogoutResponse schema
